# TestaScreen

> TestaScreen is a free web platform for testing and diagnosing computer, phone, and TV displays: dead pixel detection, color and brightness/contrast checks, full-screen color panels for photography and video lighting, and monitor buying guides. Available in English, Dutch, Spanish, and German.

TestaScreen's tools run entirely in the browser (no install, no account) and are used by photographers, videographers, gamers, and anyone checking a new or used screen for defects. Content is written and maintained by the TestaScreen team and reviewed for technical accuracy.

## Core tools

- [Dead Pixel Test](https://testascreen.com/dead-pixel-test): Detect dead, stuck, or hot pixels using full-screen color cycling.
- [Dead Pixel Fixer](https://testascreen.com/dead-pixel-fixer): Attempt to fix stuck pixels with a flickering pixel-refresh pattern.
- [Brightness Test](https://testascreen.com/brightness-test): Check screen brightness uniformity and backlight bleed.
- [Contrast Test](https://testascreen.com/contrast-test): Verify contrast levels and black/white detail.
- [White Screen](https://testascreen.com/white-screen): Full-screen white panel for cleaning checks and lighting.
- [Black Screen](https://testascreen.com/black-screen): Full-screen black panel for OLED/backlight bleed checks.
- [Color Screens](https://testascreen.com/tools): Red, blue, green, pink, purple, orange, and yellow full-screen panels.
- [Zoom Lighting](https://testascreen.com/zoom-lighting): Use your screen as a soft fill light for video calls.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All tools are free, require no sign-up, and run client-side in the browser.
- Non-English content is available under `/nl/`, `/es/`, and `/de/` path prefixes (e.g. `https://testascreen.com/nl/dead-pixel-test`).
- Full sitemap: https://testascreen.com/sitemap.xml
